interbankRate.title: Vietnam Three Month Interbank Rate
interbankRate.summary: Interbank Rate in Vietnam decreased to 7.68 percent on Tuesday June 2 from 7.86 in the previous day. Interbank Rate in Vietnam averaged 6.77 percent from 1998 until 2026, reaching an all time high of 19.77 percent in August of 2008 and a record low of 1.18 percent in November of 2020. source: The State Bank of Vietnam
